𝐍𝐎𝐓𝐇𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐁𝐄𝐀𝐓𝐒 𝐀 𝐆𝐎𝐎𝐃 𝐑𝐎𝐌𝐂𝐎𝐌 𝐃𝐔𝐑𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐅𝐀𝐋𝐋 🍂 
⁣
𝐌𝐞 𝐁𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐘𝐨𝐮 is a 2016 romantic drama adapted from the bestselling novel by Jojo Moyes, who also co-wrote the screenplay to ensure the film remained faithful to the original story. ⁣
⁣
Emilia Clarke plays Louisa “Lou” Clark, a cheerful and slightly eccentric young woman who takes a job caring for Will Traynor, played by Sam Claflin. Will was once an adventurous and successful businessman, but his life changed completely after an accident left him paralyzed. What begins as an uncomfortable relationship slowly develops into a genuine connection as Lou tries to bring some happiness and adventure back into his life.⁣
⁣
The movie was filmed across several locations in the English countryside, giving it a warm atmosphere that works especially well during the colder months. And although the critics were divided when the movie was released, particularly over how it handled disability and personal choice, audiences responded much more strongly turning 𝐌𝐞 𝐁𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐘𝐨𝐮 (𝟐𝟎𝟏𝟔) into a major commercial success.⁣
⁣
Rate 𝐌𝐞 𝐁𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐘𝐨𝐮 (𝟐𝟎𝟏𝟔) out of ten. 🔟
